title: Feeding the Lambs

readiness.math: sharing equally: the same number in each group (fair shares)
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Thank you for coming! Here are the lambs' troughs. They're hungry!

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Let's share the hay fairly, so every trough has the same.

older.prompt: Share these twelve bundles fairly between the four troughs. How many does each trough get?
older.hint: Give each trough one bundle, then go round again, until the hay is all shared.

feedback.full: That trough has its share. Try a trough with less.
feedback.all_good: Three in each trough! Twelve shared between four is three each.

steps.speaker: ruth
steps.prompt: Share the hay between the troughs. Put one bundle on each dot, so they all have the same.
steps.hint: Find a trough with an empty dot, and put a bundle there.

feedback.full: That trough has its share. Try a trough that has room.
feedback.all_good: Three, three and three. Every trough has the same. That's fair!

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: Listen to them munching! The shepherd in Jesus' story took good care of his sheep. Today, you did too.

older.journal_line: I shared twelve bundles of hay fairly between four troughs: three in each.

journal_line: I shared the hay fairly between the lambs' troughs: three bundles in each.
unavailable_text: The lambs have eaten. They're resting now.
